name: IMPACT
tagline: Understand your influence at the highest levels.
business_model: B2B + B2C — individual executive assessment with organizational applications
audience: Board members, C-suite executives, senior leaders with stakeholder-facing roles, and professionals preparing for board-level positions
delivery_format: 30-question self-assessment, instant report, optional consultant debrief for board-level applications
outcome_statement: A clear assessment of your board and stakeholder impact profile across five dimensions, your primary impact archetype (one of eight), and a targeted development roadmap to increase your influence at the highest organizational levels.
use_cases: Board preparation and board role candidacy assessment
C-suite influence and governance effectiveness evaluation
Leadership transition into board-level or stakeholder-facing roles

scoring_framework.method: Five-dimension impact profile with archetype mapping via 2×2 matrix (Strategic Oversight × Stakeholder Intelligence)
scoring_framework.archetype_detection: 8 real archetypes positioned on a 2×2 or 3×3 grid
scoring_framework.response_scale: 5-point Likert — Strongly Disagree to Strongly Agree
scoring_framework.important_note: Axis 1 and Axis 2 are structural positioning axes, NOT archetypes. They define the grid on which the 8 archetypes sit. The canon count is 8 archetypes, not 10.

dimensions.name: Strategic Oversight
dimensions.description: Your ability to provide strategic direction, set long-term vision, and oversee organizational performance at the board or executive level.

dimensions.name: Governance Rigour
dimensions.description: Your effectiveness in governance processes — fiduciary duty, risk oversight, compliance, and decision-making discipline.

dimensions.name: Stakeholder Intelligence
dimensions.description: Your ability to understand, map, and navigate multiple stakeholder groups — investors, board members, regulators, employees, customers.

dimensions.name: Mandate Legacy
dimensions.description: The lasting impact of your leadership — how well you leave organizations and teams better than you found them, and the enduring value of your contributions.

dimensions.name: Executive Presence & Influence
dimensions.description: Your ability to command attention, build credibility, and drive influence at the highest organizational levels.

archetypes.name: The Steward
archetypes.quadrant: High Strategic Oversight, High Governance Rigour
archetypes.summary: Disciplined strategic leader who balances long-term vision with rigorous governance and fiduciary responsibility.
archetypes.growth_area: Stakeholder outreach — can be too internally focused

archetypes.name: The Networker
archetypes.quadrant: High Stakeholder Intelligence, High Executive Presence
archetypes.summary: Charismatic connector with extensive stakeholder relationships and strong presence in board and executive circles.
archetypes.growth_area: Governance depth and strategic substance — can be perceived as all surface

archetypes.name: The Guardian
archetypes.quadrant: High Governance Rigour, High Mandate Legacy
archetypes.summary: Principle-driven leader who protects organizational integrity and builds institutions that outlast their tenure.
archetypes.growth_area: Adaptability — can be too conservative in fast-changing environments

archetypes.name: The Visionary
archetypes.quadrant: High Strategic Oversight, High Stakeholder Intelligence
archetypes.summary: Forward-thinking leader who sees around corners and builds coalitions of stakeholders around a compelling future vision.
archetypes.strengths: Strategic foresight, coalition building, inspirational leadership
archetypes.growth_area: Governance discipline — can overlook operational and compliance details

archetypes.name: The Bridge-Builder
archetypes.quadrant: Medium-High Stakeholder Intelligence, Medium-High Strategic Oversight
archetypes.summary: Collaborative leader who connects different stakeholder groups, builds consensus, and drives alignment across diverse interests.
archetypes.strengths: Consensus building, cross-group alignment, relationship brokerage
archetypes.growth_area: Decisiveness — can over-prioritize harmony over action

archetypes.name: The Nominee
archetypes.quadrant: Medium Governance Rigour, Medium Stakeholder Intelligence
archetypes.summary: Board-appointed or external-candidate leader with solid credentials but still building deep organizational influence and relationships.
archetypes.strengths: Fresh perspective, external expertise, formal authority
archetypes.growth_area: Organizational integration — building genuine influence beyond the title

archetypes.name: The Passenger
archetypes.quadrant: Low Strategic Oversight, Low Stakeholder Intelligence
archetypes.summary: Leader at the board or executive level who is present but not driving impact — going through the motions rather than shaping outcomes.
archetypes.growth_area: Everything — active engagement, strategic contribution, relationship building

archetypes.name: The Strategic Builder
archetypes.quadrant: High Mandate Legacy, High Strategic Oversight
archetypes.summary: Transformation-focused leader who leaves a legacy of structural change — builds institutions, reshapes strategies, and creates lasting value.
archetypes.strengths: Strategic transformation, legacy building, institutional change
archetypes.growth_area: Stakeholder management during transformation — can leave people behind

pillar_mapping.relationship: IMPACT is the flagship of P3 — the highest-level assessment focused on board and executive stakeholder impact
cross_pillar_relevance: P1 Talent Pipeline Health — board-level readiness is the ultimate pipeline metric
P2 Cross-Border Leadership Effectiveness — cross-border stakeholders add complexity to impact dynamics

key_methodological_notes: 8 real archetypes — Axis 1 and Axis 2 are grid axes, not archetypes
Composite score combines all 5 dimensions with equal weighting
Report includes dimension profile, archetype deep dive, and development roadmap

naming_origin.reason: IMPACT is broader than just board effectiveness — it covers stakeholder intelligence, mandate legacy, and executive presence. 'Board Effectiveness' is too narrow and is a B2B organizational framing; the product is individual-level.

dimension_name_changes.APAC Mandate Credibility: Renamed to Executive Presence & Influence — removed the narrow 'APAC Mandate' framing which is BRIDGE's territory, and more accurately describes the dimension's focus on credibility and influence at senior levels

archetype_name_changes.The Architect: Renamed to The Strategic Builder — removed 'Architect' banned word, better captures the transformation and legacy-building focus

provenance.dimensions: impact_config.json + IMPACT_QB_notion.json — 5 dimensions validated across both sources, D5 realigned to broader framing
provenance.archetypes: impact_config.json — 10 entries total; 2 are matrix axes (Axis 1, Axis 2) and 8 are real archetypes
